# Pull request checklist

- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all pass locally
- [ ] Scientific-data implications described below (schema, vocabularies, demo dataset, releases)
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior, schema, or policy changes
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, service-role keys, PATs, LLM API keys)
- [ ] Demo/sample data is clearly labeled and never presented as curated production data
- [ ] Existing records were preserved — no destructive rewrites of data or history
